text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the time off I received,
I was able to tackle my reading backlog all at once...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
With this, I feel like I can give it my all
and truly focus on my training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Zenno Rob Roy was able to
spend a fulfilling day off.
